formation: Depicts a hand restraining a domestic animal (㣇) by holding its tail (隶). 㣇 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "kill domestic animals and display them". The meaning later shifted to "shop", "wanton", "unrestrained", and "indulge".

components.note: Depicts a wild animal. Modern form looks like 镸.
Depicts a hand (又) grabbing a tail (尾). Modern form looks like 聿.
